author: Holger Klemm, Kevin Ertel
name: enfuseAdvanced
description: Adds an export module that aligns and blends bracketed or focus-shifted image sets into a single dynamic-range-increased or focus-stacked image.
description-extensive: This export module merges a series of photos into one improved picture, either combining different exposures for greater dynamic range or blending shots focused at different distances for front-to-back sharpness (focus stacking). You pick your bracketed or focus-shifted images, set your options, and it produces a new blended image that can be imported back automatically. It needs the free programs align_image_stack, enfuse (version 4.2 or newer), and exiftool installed.
